## About Me

I am a data analyst based in Melbourne, completing a Master of Business Analytics at **Monash University** (expected July 2027). Before that I studied **Economics** at Fergusson College, Pune, which is where I got hooked on using data to answer real questions about policy, health and business.

I care about getting the method right and then explaining the result plainly: what the data shows, how confident we can be, and what it does not tell us.

## Experience

**Data Analyst Intern, Educators SA** (industry placement through Monash, remote) · *August 2026 – present*\
Building a member engagement model for a peak body representing around 15,000 educators across 61 associations. I built a reproducible R pipeline that joins membership and event data into an association-level feature table, and deployed an R Shiny dashboard that scores and segments engagement so leadership can track and act on it.

**HR Analytics Intern, Suzlon Energy** (Pune) · *June – August 2023*\
Analysed recruitment data in Excel and R and built Tableau dashboards to report key HR metrics.

## Projects

Every post on this site is written in Quarto, with the full code on GitHub.

-   [**Did closing police station counters increase crime in Victoria?**](posts/police_closure/police_station_closure.qmd) A difference-in-differences and event-study analysis of Victoria Police's 2023-24 reception hour cuts across 79 local government areas.
-   [**How busy are Melbourne's CBD crossings?**](posts/pedestrian/pedestrian.qmd) Modelling pedestrian counts with probability distributions, bootstrapping and confidence intervals.
-   [**Do fast pit stops win F1 races?**](posts/f1/f1.qmd) Regression and bootstrap analysis of Formula 1 pit stop times and race results.

## Skills

-   **Languages and tools:** R, Python, SQL, Git and GitHub, Excel, SPSS
-   **Visualisation and reporting:** ggplot2, R Shiny, Plotly, Tableau, Quarto, R Markdown
-   **Methods:** regression and econometric modelling, causal inference (difference-in-differences, fixed effects, event studies), hypothesis testing, bootstrapping, time series analysis, predictive modelling, data cleaning and wrangling

## Outside Work

I prioritise health and balance: I train regularly and keep learning about nutrition. I also enjoy hands-on creative work, like building LEGO or cooking, and I unwind by rewatching a few of my favourite series.
